sloka: ऋषयश्च महात्मानः सर्व एव महीसुराः ।अन्वगच्छन्महात्मानं स्वर्गद्वारमपावृतम् ।। ७.१०९.९ ॥
transliteration: ṛṣayaśca mahātmānaḥ sarva eva mahīsurāḥ ।anvagacchanmahātmānaṁ svargadvāramapāvṛtam ।। 7.109.9 ॥

translations.english: All the great-souled sages and Brahmins followed the great-souled Rama to the open gate of heaven.
